notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by an ordinary regional interaction. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, DDM dimensions, endpoint, callback model, and interaction/parameter/transportation names. It verifies dimensional handle and metadata lookups, region creation and bounds, regional interaction publication, subscription, send and receive delivery, source-region metadata, overlap filtering, parameter/tag identity, and transportation identity without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction publication, subscription, send, region, and transportation services with FederateAmbassador interaction-delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional interaction declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
